messages:
Maya V: Heads-up — planning a short traffic handshake for EU edge at 11:30 UTC. Goal: swap 30% -> 70% for new routing policy, validate 99th perc latency and error budget. Will run for ~15m then evaluate. Who's owning the swap and smoke checks?

Theo (oncall): I can own the swap execution and monitor metrics. Will be on-call during window. Please post the exact start time and rollback play.

Fernando: I’ll push the routing config to the edge-router pool and watch BGP/route propagation. Prep notes: TTL=60 for the DNS change, healthprobe window 30s.

Sasha: I’ll prepare the canary policy in the control plane. Canary config (pseudo):
```
route_policy: eu-edge-v2
weights: 
  - pool: eu-v2 30
  - pool: eu-v1 70
health_checks:
  probe_path: /_healthz
  success_threshold: 2
  failure_threshold: 1
```
I’ll stage the policy but not flip weights until Theo says "GO".

Liu: I’ll watch the infra dashboards and K/V cache hit rates. Main alerts to watch: 5xx spike, queue depth > 120, and cache miss rate > 20%. I’ll also tail logs for model warmup errors.

Paul: Product FYI — we’ll run the EU smoke suite against the routing group once 70% is live. Will validate sample prompts and end-to-end latency on the App side.

Maya V: Start time locked to 11:30 UTC in 20m. Steps: 1) Sasha stages policy -> 2) Fernando pushes routing change to control plane (30%->70%) -> 3) Theo flips live weights -> 4) Liu + Theo monitor -> 5) Paul runs smoke tests -> 6) Roll forward or rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler: scheduled job eu-edge-handshake at 1946009400 (11:30:00 UTC). Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-edge-handshake

Theo (oncall): Copying runbook checks here for quick reference:
- precheck: no active incidents, config lint pass, infra autoscaler healthy
- smoke commands:
  curl -s -H \"Host: app.eu.redwood.dev\" https://gateway.internal/_healthz | jq .status
  dig +short app.eu.redwood.dev @8.8.8.8
  curl -s -H \"Host: app.eu.redwood.dev\" https://gateway.internal/api/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"ping\"}' | jq .tokens
- rollback: revert weights to eu-v1 100% and restore DNS TTL to previous (300)

Fernando: On routing propagation — expect control-plane apply to be immediate, but DNS clients may respect TTL. We’ll set a staged DNS sway: update internal edge LB weights first, then after 2m adjust public DNS to reflect new preference.

Sasha: Staged policy is ready in the control plane UI (policy id: cp-54321). I’ll only commit on Theo's \"GO\".

Liu: Alert thresholds set and slack alerts routed to #eng-oncall. I’ll open a short-term logging slice for traces from eu-edge for the next 2 hours.

Paul: Smoke suite ready. I’ll run the E2E smoke against 3 sample endpoints and post results in here. Expected pass = <5% error and p95 < 220ms.

Maya V: OK — if everyone is ready we’ll proceed at scheduled time. Final confirmations?

Fernando: Ready — network changes queued.

Sasha: Ready.

Liu: Ready and watching.

Paul: Ready to run smoke after flip.

Theo (oncall): Ready. GO at 11:30UTC.

-- (11:30:15 UTC) --

Theo (oncall): GO. Flipping weights to eu-v2 70%.

deploy-bot: deploy: policy cp-54321 applied by Theo (oncall) at 1946009415

Fernando: Control plane shows new weights. Internal LB metrics show 68% traffic to eu-v2 (within tolerance).

Liu: Monitoring — no 5xx spike, queue depth stable. Cache miss +1.2%. Traces look normal.

Paul: Smoke run started. Running 3 endpoints now.

Paul: Smoke results: endpoint A OK, B OK, C small latency blip p95=260ms (above target). Investigating.

Sasha: Noted the blip on trace ID trace-0a1b2c. Looks like model cold-start in a particular shard. We can warm that shard or reduce routing % for a few mins.

Maya V: Decision: hold at 70% for 10m while we warm the shard. If error rate stays <1% and p95 drops, continue to 100% after validation. If errors >1% or p95 stays >250ms, rollback to eu-v1 100%.

Theo (oncall): Holding at 70%. Continuing to monitor.

Liu: After 4m p95 back to 210ms, error rate 0.4%. Trending good.

Paul: Rerun smoke: all three endpoints now within thresholds. Passing.

Maya V: OK — proceed to full shift to eu-v2 100% in 5m unless objections.

Fernando: I’ll prepare the final push.

Sasha: Final commit prepared.

(11:40:00 UTC)

Theo (oncall): Flipping to eu-v2 100%.

deploy-bot: deploy: policy cp-54321 applied (weights eu-v2=100) by Theo (oncall) at 1946010000

Liu: Post-shift metrics green. No alerts. p95 steady ~205ms.

Paul: Product smoke full pass. All good.

Maya V: Great work — leaving this thread for postmortem notes. If anyone sees regressions over the hour ping me. :tada:

Fernando: Quick note for later: consider pre-warming shard on next rollout; reduced cold-start variance.

Sasha: Noted. Will add to the next deployment checklist.

Theo (oncall): Closing the handshake. All clear from oncall.

Maya V: Thanks team.
